releases.notes: 长列表改用框架级虚拟列表 aibox/ui（动态行高实测回填、行矩形接入原生手势层），删除本地兜底实现

localizedNotes.en: Switch the transactions list to the framework VirtualList from aibox/ui and drop the local fallback

localizedNotes.en: Add a .tests.json regression suite covering the full create-entry business flow

releases.notes: 子页导航改用系统原生页栈：项目/账户详情左滑返回时实时透出上一页、可中途放弃，不再直接退出整个小应用；顶栏不再与宿主重复画一层；tabs.changed 现在消费 rendered。

localizedNotes.en: Subpages now mirror into the host's native page stack: swiping back from a project or account detail reveals the previous page live and can be abandoned mid-drag, instead of dismissing the whole applet. No more duplicated navigation bar, and tabs.changed now consumes rendered.
